title: ThreadRelay protocol v1
description: Private parent/child IPC. Four-byte unsigned big-endian byte length; UTF-8 JSON; payload 1..1048576 bytes. No generic setup, URL, file, process or shell bridge.

minimum_score.description: Uncalibrated model relevance cutoff; not a probability. Missing uses 0.9.

TopicResult.description: Optional score is not a calibrated probability; outputs contain no destinations or actions.

allow_unverified_source.description: Explicit exact-route consent for link-only sharing of audience-unverified visible sources under the topic_score policy. Omitted or false preserves public-only Auto.

Delivery.description: id is the durable delivery/operation identity, deduplicated by account_id+post_id+destination_id independently of sender. message_id is a legacy final_message_id alias, never the temporary ID. claim/attempt correlation is not authorization to send.

continuous.description: Keep collecting across internal pages until explicit Pause/Stop or a hard dependency failure. Ignores duration/post caps; automatic delivery budgets still apply.

unlimited_auto_deliveries.description: Explicitly keep automatic delivery running without a per-session count cap. Pause/Stop, route timing and Telegram-required waits still apply. Omitted or false keeps max_auto_deliveries, including zero disabling sends.

SessionConfig.description: Collection and automatic delivery limits are separate. Unlimited automatic delivery requires explicit unlimited_auto_deliveries=true; zero max_auto_deliveries still disables automatic starts when the unlimited flag is absent or false.

config.description: Last successfully promoted session configuration; absent during a new unpromoted start.

DeliveryProposal.description: Routing emits plan_id, contributing route_refs and destination revision/audience. Legacy DTOs without these are display/evaluation only, never approval or send authority.

ShutdownReport.description: Remaining names are diagnostics, never process handles or renderer-supplied control targets.

synthetic.description: Required by the offline evaluation API. Synthetic data never supplies release evidence.

EvaluationReport.description: Metrics are report data only, never classifier actions or routing input.

TelegramId.description: Canonical signed 64-bit decimal string; never a JavaScript Number. Numeric conversion belongs exclusively in the trusted TDLib boundary. Absolute-end assertion excludes trailing line terminators consistently across runtime validators.

AccountEpoch.description: Application revocation generation, not a TDLib ID.

AccountSnapshot.description: Application status only, never reusable secrets, phone/code/password or raw TDLib updates. Does not construct a TDLib client or grant network permission.

AuthChallenge.description: Opaque challenge metadata only; secure submission operations and state transitions belong to account onboarding, not generic IPC.

TelegramAttempt.description: Durable ordered own-send correlation only. Initial temporary message is not Sent; no API response, message content or secret fields. request_extra correlates @extra and is not server idempotency.

AutoPreviewReceipt.description: Opaque backend-issued exact Auto preview binding; not a renderer authorization flag.

AuthCodeDelivery.description: Allowlisted delivery channel and server wait only. Never a phone number, code, password, URL or raw native payload.
